statement: Separate planned synchronization from achieved synchronization; doctrine can be mature while execution degrades under CAP/AA/radio/maneuver.
Use time-based, radio-cued, visual-cued and event-cued synchronization; robust plans combine them.
SYNC0 fragmented, SYNC1 phase-order only, SYNC2 leader-coordinated, SYNC3 locally well-synchronized; no missile-era precision timing.
Track synchronization separately at assembly/route, target acquisition, attack commitment and final release.
COM2/A-CMD2 supports SYNC1-2 normally; A-CMD3/COM3 can produce local SYNC3; leader loss/congestion degrades state.
Suppression/manuever effects only help later exposures/releases if physically earlier; no retroactive benefit.
CAP/AA can defeat a mixed strike by delay/displacement/desynchronization without high kill count; track delayed/displaced/wrong-phase separately.
Enterprise is first major live synchronization stress test of prewar FT/Type91 doctrine. Resolve SYNC S1-S4 before valid-release bands.
